title: Herbal Crispy Portuguese Tempeh Kebabs
description: A zesty, crispy tempeh kebab infused with Portuguese herbs, perfect for a quick, comforting lunch on a sick day.

ingredients.name: skewers
ingredients.notes: wooden or metal, soaked if wooden

instructions: Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes to prevent burning.
Pat dry tempeh cubes with paper towels.
In a bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, honey, smoked paprika, cumin, garlic powder, onion powder, oregano, thyme, chili flakes, and a pinch of salt.
Add tempeh cubes to the bowl and toss until evenly coated. Let marinate for 10 minutes.
Thread marinated tempeh onto skewers, leaving a small gap between each cube to allow even cooking.

Preheat a grill or grill pan over medium-high heat. Place the kebabs on the grill and cook 4-5 minutes per side, or until the tempeh is crispy and golden and the internal temperature reaches 70°C (158°F).
Remove from heat and sprinkle with fresh parsley.
Serve hot with a side of roasted vegetables or a simple green salad to keep it light and soothing.
